+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,20 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+python -m pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or test with:
+
+```sh
+python -m pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py
+python -m pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Note: the repository does not contain any tests yet, so the command above
+currently collects zero items. Add test modules under `tests/` named
+`test_*.py` and pytest will pick them up automatically.
